title: Foo Bar Full OLAP Pipeline
description: Build a complete real-time analytics pipeline: HTTP ingestion endpoint, Redpanda buffer, ClickHouse landing, materialized views, and egress APIs. Seed data is posted through the agent's own ingestion endpoint.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must build an end-to-end streaming pipeline from HTTP ingestion through Redpanda to ClickHouse with materialized views and egress APIs.

tasks.description: Stand up an HTTP endpoint that accepts JSON event POSTs and forwards them to a Redpanda topic.
Consume the Redpanda topic and land events in a ClickHouse base table.
Create pre-aggregated tables or materialized views for top products, conversion funnel, and hourly activity.
Expose three HTTP endpoints that serve pre-aggregated insights under 200ms.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse and Redpanda installed but not running. 40 product interaction events as JSON files in /data/events/ that the agent must POST through their own ingestion endpoint.
